### Geographic Distribution

```{python}
# load counties map data
geojson_path = data_dir / "county_fips_codes/geojson_counties_fips.json"

with open(geojson_path, "r") as f:
    counties_geojson = json.load(f)
```


```{python}
# define map layout function

def apply_map_layout_and_controls(fig, title_text):
    """
    Applies the carto-positron map style and explicit US centering
    to an existing static Plotly map figure.
    """
    fig.update_layout(
        title=title_text,
        map_style="carto-positron",
        map_zoom=2,
        map_center={"lat": 37.0902, "lon": -95.7129}, 
        margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=50, b=0)
    )
    return fig
```


#### Missingness Check
```{python}
# create map of counties for which we have data
def plot_county_coverage(df, table_name, value_col):
    map_df = df["county_id"].dropna().drop_duplicates()
    
    if map_df.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No valid county data found for {table_name}")

    fig = go.Figure(
        data=[
            go.Choroplethmap(
                geojson=counties_geojson,
                locations=map_df,
                z=[1] * len(map_df),
                featureidkey="id",
                colorscale=[[0, "#fff9f9"], [1, "#2cb94f"]],
                zmin=0,
                zmax=1,
                marker_opacity=0.35,
                marker_line_width=0.3,
                showscale=False,
                hovertemplate="County FIPS: %{location}<br>Has data: Yes<extra></extra>"
            )
        ]
    )
        
    title_text = f"{table_name}: {value_col} County Coverage"
    
    fig = mu.apply_map_layout_and_controls(fig, title_text)

    return fig

fig = plot_county_coverage(df, "Data Centers", "county coverage")
fig.show()
```



#### Values by County

```{python}
# create a choropleth map of counties for a set of desired variables in the df

# Update these:
eda_table_name = "Data Centers"
cols_to_use = [1,2]

df_agg = df[["sqft", "county_id"]]
df_agg = df_agg.groupby("county_id").agg(["mean", "count"])
df_agg.columns = ["sqft_mean", "county_count"]
df_agg = df_agg.reset_index()

cols_agg = df_agg.columns

for i in cols_to_use:
    value_col = cols_agg[i]
    

    map_df = df_agg[["county_id", value_col]].dropna()

    if map_df.empty:
        print(f"Skipping {value_col}: No valid data found.")
        continue

    value_min = map_df[value_col].min()
    value_max = map_df[value_col].max()

    fig = go.Figure(
        data=[
            go.Choroplethmap(
                geojson=counties_geojson, 
                locations=map_df["county_id"],
                z=map_df[value_col],
                featureidkey="id",
                colorscale="Viridis",
                zmin=value_min,
                zmax=value_max,
                marker_opacity=0.5,
                marker_line_width=0.3,
                colorbar=dict(title=value_col),
                hovertemplate=f"County FIPS: %{{location}}<br>{value_col}: %{{z}}<extra></extra>"
            )
        ]
    )
        
    title_text = f"{eda_table_name}: {value_col} County Coverage"
    fig = mu.apply_map_layout_and_controls(fig, title_text)

    fig.show()
```
